text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding nova13b-int3 landed on staging. Quick metric note: rouge-avg dropped ~6% on longform tests vs q4b baseline. I dumped ~50 example prompts to /tmp/nova13b_longform_fails.json for curation. tagging @olivia @tom for dedupe + quant checks.

olivia: On it — first pass looks like a tokenizer-tokenhash mismatch for a subset, plus a few paraphrase dups. Can you confirm whether the ingest used tokenizer v2 or v3?

tom: Quick note: I kicked off a quant-smoke for int3 artifacts. Found increased hallucination cases at seq>2048 and a kernel fallback on some GPUs. Will paste logs.

label-bot: Attached sample list (50) available at s3://redwood-staging/nova13b/fails/3632109877-sample.json (ACL: eng-ml-read).

maya: ingest used tokenizer v3. Plan proposal: create a temporary golden set "nova13b-longform-regression" = 200 cases (100 hallucination-sensitive, 100 format/truncation). De-dup those against existing golden using fingerprint v2. @olivia can you run dedupe with threshold config below?

olivia: Yes. Using dedupe rules: cosine >= 0.92 on embed-512 AND tokenhash exact match => drop. For paraphrase near-duplicates we'll cluster at 0.88 and surface top exemplar. Kicking off now.

tom: Quant findings summary: ```
# quant-smoke summary
model: nova13b-int3
problem: hallucination spike on long prompts >2048
observed: KV cache misalignment + different attention kernel chosen on A100 driver v5.3
workaround: route longform requests to nova13b-q4b-compat until kernel patch
```

sara: Label ops can take 200 items in ~24-36h if we provide: 1) clear rubric, 2) 6 examples per failure type, 3) de-duped list and manifest. Who's owning the rubric?

maya: I'll draft rubric now. Key points: what counts as hallucination (unsupported facts vs plausible inference), formatting/truncation criteria, and whether partial answer salvageable. Example entries:
```
Case A (hallucination): prompt asks for invoice totals, model fabricates vendor names not in prompt => label: HALLUCINATION
Case B (truncation): model cuts off mid-sentence at token boundary => label: TRUNCATION
Case C (formatting): list items collapsed into single paragraph => label: FORMAT
```

label-bot: Labeling manifest created: s3://redwood-staging/nova13b/manifest_3632109877.csv. Contains md5, tokenhash_v3, embed512 float32 hex, source_prompt_id.

olivia: Dedupe run complete: 14 exact tokenhash matches removed, 7 near-duplicates merged (cluster exemplar kept). Final golden candidate pool: 179 items. Pushing to /tmp/golden_candidates_3632109877.json.

tom: Will update routing policy: longform (estimated tokens > 1800) => nova13b-q4b-compat until runtime kernel bump. I'll add a canary route to 10% traffic for 6h post-patch.

maya: Great. Sara — please confirm labeler start time once rubric + manifest are updated (expecting start by EOD). I'll open a brief canary eval in eval-harness and post results here when ready.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: nova13b-q4b-compat -> staging (10% traffic) at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z.

tom: (:thumbsup:) will follow up in #eng-runtime with rollout note and kernel ticket link.
